messages:
Samir Nadar: Heads up — CloudVendor just pushed our reserved rack ETA out to ~6 weeks instead of 2. This directly impacts the joint marketplace launch we discussed for mid-May.
Priya Desai: Wait, timeline change? Did they give a reason?
Samir Nadar: Freight congestion + a firmware hold on the r5-42 SKU. They offered a split shipment: ~60% by 2025-05-01, remainder by 2025-06-15. Language was 'soft promise'.
Lena Ortiz: If only 60% arrives before launch, do we have capacity for canary + paid customers?
Alex Chen: Not without changes — our planned canary needs full hot-path GPUs to hit X QPS. Short version: either degrade to a smaller model for initial traffic, route overflow to hosted fallback, or throttle invites.
Priya Desai: Marketing already has a co-announcement draft with CloudVendor for 05/14. Jules, do we pull or pivot?
Jules (marketing): We can't run a joint press release without firm capacity assurances. Options: delay the announcement, run a soft partner blog/community post, or publish with vague language ("available soon") and no launch date. Not ideal.
Samir Nadar: Partner wants to keep the 5/14 date. They offered a commercial concession: uptime/availability credit if we go live and they underdeliver.
Legal-BOT: Noted. Any credit needs a signed amendment specifying metrics, remedy, and cap. I can review an emergency amendment draft if they send terms.
OrionSysBot: Orion SI flagged a blocker: integration sign-off depends on hardware parity in staging. If ~40% of racks are delayed, they won't sign-off for 5/14.
Alex Chen: Possible mitigation: route some test traffic to cloud-hosted overlay capacity (temporary), but that will increase run-rate cost by ~2.8x on those nodes. We can gate invites to limit spend.
Lena Ortiz: We need concrete numbers: projected QPS shortfall and incremental overlay spend for a 2-week period.
Samir Nadar: Action: I'll request a binding partial-manifest and final ETA from CloudVendor by EOD. Need exact SKUs and serial ranges.
Priya Desai: Action: Jules to prepare contingency messaging options (delay / limited launch / announcement-without-date) and a FAQ for partners and sales by EOD.
Jules (marketing): Roger — I'll include suggested embargo language and a staging timeline for PR.
Alex Chen: Action: I'll prepare a feature-flagged routing plan so we can gate the joint release behind a capacity check. Will prototype tomorrow AM.
Samir Nadar: If partner can't provide a split manifest, recommended fallback = delay joint announcement by 3 weeks and propose a co-hosted webinar the original week instead.
Priya Desai: +1 to webinar as consolation offering.
Lena Ortiz: Quick finance question — how much of the PO is already paid / committed?
Samir Nadar: PO#8891 — 70% deposit paid, 120 racks reserved.
Legal-BOT: Reminder: changing delivery schedule may trigger supplier penalty/credit clauses. Negotiation needs to be documented and signed.
Samir Nadar: Will coordinate with procurement/legal. I'll update this thread when I have the manifest or formal amendment. /cc @Jules (marketing) @Alex Chen
Priya Desai: If we don't have a confirmed manifest by 3pm PST tomorrow we should formally vote to delay the joint press.
Jules (marketing): noted :calendar:
Alex Chen: agreed
OrionSysBot: Reminder scheduled for 15:00 PST tomorrow.
Samir Nadar: Update (partner reply): CloudVendor says split manifest available by 17:00 PT today, tentative 65% early ship. They also propose 30 days waived node fees for shortfall days and a service credit if outages exceed SLA thresholds.
Priya Desai: Good — please drop the manifest link here when available.
Lena Ortiz: I'll run a fast capacity model once manifest is live to quantify shortfall and cost delta.
Samir Nadar: Manifest link (internal): https://files.cloudvendor.com/manifest/8891-split — contains SKUs, serial ranges, partial ETAs.
Jules (marketing): Okay — pause public comms until we confirm the model impact and legal signs off on the amendment. Great job moving fast, team. :eyes:
